name: cub-200-2011-clip-benchmark
description: The CUB-200-2011 CLIP benchmark is a fine-grained bird species image classification benchmark adapted to evaluate CLIP-style models (often in zero-shot or linear-probe settings). It measures a model's ability to discriminate among 200 closely related bird species, stressing fine-grained visual recognition and class-discriminative representations. Researchers use it to evaluate representation quality, transfer performance, and robustness of vision-language models on detailed natural categories.
reputation: A standard and well-known fine-grained classification benchmark in the computer vision community.
